sharedPredictionLogic.selectionRule: danger=lowest total among estimated-popularity top3; exclude danger; select top min(ceil(field/2),7) total; main=top total; second=lowest estimated popularity among selected

strictInputRules.predictionSnapshotPolicy: historical cache physically strips target-race current odds, actual popularity, horse bodyweight and archived score/rank/ml_* outputs before rebuild; any residual post/start-time field in a cached prediction snapshot is rejected; race_cards are also stripped of current market/bodyweight fields
strictInputRules.legacySnapshotPolicy: old snapshots remain eligible after leakage/legacy-output columns are sanitized; archived model scores/ranks are never reused and all derived indices are rebuilt from immutable pre-race facts through scripts/prediction_logic_candidate.py
strictInputRules.actualPopularityUse: teacher label only; each race excluded from its own estimator training
strictInputRules.nonStarterHandling: cancelled/excluded horses are retained in pre-race prediction candidates but omitted from final-popularity teacher rows and validation metrics
strictInputRules.indexDetailHistoryCutoff: previous-run/detail indices use only cached archived race results with date < target race date
strictInputRules.historicalFactsCachePolicy: immutable source facts are cached once; derived indices and prediction selections are recalculated on every rebuild so logic changes take effect immediately
strictInputRules.raceConditionMetadataFallback: surface/distance may fall back to target result metadata or an authoritative race-program override; if still missing, v3 今回走/コース適性 degrades neutrally instead of aborting. Target result performance is never used
strictInputRules.indexDetailFailurePolicy: no legacy score fallback is allowed; every race must be derivable through the shared prediction core, otherwise the rebuild reports the input error
